metadata.name: Geopotential Height Styles
metadata.description: Styles for geopotential height in decameters (dkm). Standard meteorological unit for upper-air charts. Data is stored in geopotential meters, so the transform is x 0.1 (5500 gpm = 550 dkm). Colour range and contours are tuned for the 500 mb surface (typically ~540-580 dkm); other pressure levels sit outside it (1000 mb is about 0 dkm, 100 mb about 1650 dkm) and draw in the end colours or without contours.

gradient.name: Geopotential Height
gradient.description: Geopotential height colored by elevation in decameters (tuned for the 500 mb surface: 480-600 dkm range)

isolines.name: Geopotential Contours
isolines.description: Geopotential height contour lines at 6 dkm intervals (standard)
